title: CloudTrail has no trail on development and no S3 or DynamoDB data events in any environment
description: From PR 551: development has only the 90-day CloudTrail event history, so an investigation can see who got a role session but not what the session did; the Front Door file audit does not cover direct S3 or DynamoDB access by a leaked credential. Decide and build a trail with data events for the snapshot bucket, the PiSessions bucket and the messaging table (cost-aware: data events are billed per event; scope to the sensitive prefixes), in CDK, for development first. Acceptance: a read made by the owner role appears in the trail; cost estimate documented in the ticket; runbook section 9 updated; UNVERIFIED item U10 resolved.

comments.author: home
comments.text: R2 check: no CloudTrail trail exists in the production account (any region, including shadow trails), none in the management account, no organization trail, no delegated administrators, no CloudTrail Lake store. Built a cheap management-events-only trail (ChatticusAuditTrail, production stack set): PR 625. Cost estimate: first copy free; S3 storage and PUTs cents a month (38 events in 24h observed). Not covered: S3 and DynamoDB data events (by decision). Secrets Manager GetSecretValue is covered (AWS docs confirm all Secrets Manager API calls are recorded). Awaiting CI and merge; deploy after merge.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed ChatticusAuditTrail to the production account on 2026-10-20 (diff showed only a new bucket, bucket policy and trail; deploy 27s). Verified: trail chatticus-audit-trail IsLogging true, multi-region true, log file validation true, global service events on, no KMS key, no CloudWatch Logs, no Insights, event selector management events ReadWriteType All with no DataResources. Bucket: block public access all four on, SSE-S3 (AES256), 400 day expiry, 7 day multipart abort, policy allows only cloudtrail.amazonaws.com conditioned on this trail's ARN plus a TLS-only deny. Delivery: first log file landed about 3 minutes after deploy, get-trail-status LatestDeliveryError none. Closing as done for management events: the owner decided NOT to enable S3 and DynamoDB data events for cost, so the acceptance items for data events (an owner-role read appearing in the trail, scoped data events) are intentionally not met. Follow-up note: if data events are ever wanted, open a new ticket with a per-event cost estimate and prefix scoping; U10 is resolved as 'not recorded, by decision'. Docs PR 627 records the deploy date in the revocation runbook.

right_now_summary: A CDK CloudTrail trail with scoped S3 and DynamoDB data events still needs to be built for development.
